title: Spot-bleaching of C. elegans nematode worms
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5ueg6te

steps.title: Apply bleaching solution to NGM plate
steps.instruction: Place a 20 to 50 µl drop of bleaching solution on the edge of a clean NGM plate seeded with E. coli.

steps.title: Pick gravid hermaphrodites
steps.instruction: Pick several gravid hermaphrodites into the bleaching solution drop.

steps.title: Recover and transfer L1 larvae
steps.instruction: The following day, once L1 larvae have crawled into the E. coli OP50 lawn, move them to a new environment.
